build_task_template: build a phyre task template that places a dynamic jar vase and vertical bar in the scene
add_dynamic_objects: create dynamic jar and bar objects using C.add with scale angle and position parameters
update_task_relationships: define the task goal by setting body1 and body2 with a TOUCHING spatial relationship
set_solution_tier: set the task metadata to SolutionTier.BALL using C.set_meta on the creator context
skip_invalid_params: raise SkipTemplateParams when the bar is too close to scene edges to form a valid task
